tasks.prompt: Following the project's AGENTS.md, set up a React + TypeScript web application with Vite and React Router. There is no backend and no 3D. Add the required scripts, a simple project structure, and reusable base components. Prepare the /, /recipes, /recipes/:id, and /favorites routes, with a shared navigation and a 404 page. Keep the app compiling and leave a clear foundation for adding recipes, search, and favorites in the following tasks.

Build on the existing app with a small set of typed local recipes and an accessible list page at /recipes. Add search and useful filters, such as category or preparation time, and synchronize their values with URL parameters so views can be shared and restored. Handle the no-results state and use reusable components. Preserve the established routes and structure, and ensure the project builds.

Add a recipe detail view at /recipes/:id with its ingredients and instructions, along with favorites persisted in localStorage. Create the /favorites page to display and remove favorite recipes, including an empty state. Handle unknown IDs gracefully and connect the views with navigation links. Reuse the typed data and existing components, then ensure the project builds.

Finish the recipe app by refining its responsive layout and accessibility: keyboard navigation, explicit labels, a consistent heading structure, readable contrast, and visible focus states. Review the home, list, detail, favorites, and 404 views, along with the no-results, unknown-recipe, and empty-favorites states. Fix any integration or functional issues without adding unnecessary dependencies. Before finishing, verify that the project builds without errors and that the main features work correctly.
